summary.name: Wordware
summary.one_liner: Wordware is an AI context lab in San Francisco whose main product, Sauna, is an AI assistant built for compounding context and proactive work.
summary.what_it_does: Wordware describes itself as an AI context lab based in San Francisco with the premise that words are the next programming language. Its main product, Sauna, is presented as an AI assistant built for compounding context. According to the page, Sauna learns the user's taste, detects hidden patterns, augments the user's brain context, and works proactively. The page also describes Sauna as an intelligent workspace that eliminates busywork and anticipates what comes next. The page gives no technical detail on how these features are implemented.
notable: Joined Y Combinator and raised a reported $30M seed round, described as the largest in YC history
Claims the #1 Product Hunt launch of all time
Sauna learns user taste and detects hidden patterns proactively
Backed by angels including Paul Graham and Swyx
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete technical details
